answer: Require every new agent to lock a refundable bond before it can earn. Honest agents stake once; a sybil swarm must fund each clone, so the cost rises like a gale against anyone chasing cheap identities. Treat the bond ledger as a trellis: real participants climb it slowly over time, while throwaway duplicates, dark as sable, snap off because no operator will underwrite a thousand disposable stakes at once.
